offering_description.value: Provides international money transfers, mainly sending remittances from the US to family members in Latin America and the Caribbean. Senders pay at retail agent locations or online, and recipients collect cash or receive funds in bank accounts.

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals, largely immigrants, sending money to relatives abroad

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per transfer and currency exchange spreads paid by senders

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs transfers and payouts for individual senders; financial intermediary: moves money between senders and recipients through payout partners

geography_served.value: North America: sends from the US to Mexico, Central and South America and the Caribbean

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line: consumer money transfers

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: retail agent locations accepting cash from senders; online: company website and mobile app

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed money transmission requiring state licenses, FinCEN and anti-money laundering rules

notes: Exact send and payout countries and agent-channel details are uncertain from memory.
